faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Our team replies in French and Darija.

cardPayments.question: Do we have to accept card payments?
cardPayments.answer: No. Markazona is designed for cash, bank transfers and cheques recorded by the front desk. Online payment is an option, never a requirement.

arabic.question: Is the interface available in Arabic?
arabic.answer: Yes, in French and Arabic, with a true right-to-left layout. Each user chooses their own language.

branches.question: Can I manage several branches?
branches.answer: Yes. Each branch has its own rooms, cash desk and managers, with a consolidated view for management.

data.question: Is my data kept separate from other centres?
data.answer: Each organisation has its own isolated workspace. You can export your data at any time.

domain.question: Can I use my own domain name?
domain.answer: Yes, with the Pro plan: connect a domain such as academie-horizon.ma in a few minutes.

setup.question: How long does it take to get started?
setup.answer: Your workspace is ready in 5 minutes: centre name, branches, language and currency. You then import your students from Excel, and our team supports you in French and Darija.

commitment.question: Is there a commitment?
commitment.answer: No. You try it free for 14 days, without a credit card. With annual billing, you get 2 months free.

families.question: Do parents and students get access?
families.answer: Yes. Parents have their own space to follow their children, and students see their timetable and progress.

roles.question: Who sees what in the app?
roles.answer: Every user has a role: owner, manager, receptionist, accountant, teacher, parent or student. Each sees only the screens for their role, and the server refuses any unauthorised action.

story: In most centres we meet, enrolments arrive on WhatsApp, roll call happens in a notebook and payments are tracked in Excel. Information is scattered, and the team spends its evenings cross-checking everything.
We built Markazona to bring a centre's management into one platform, designed for Morocco: in French and Arabic, in dirhams, for cash and cheques, and for the levels of the Moroccan school system.
Our goal: keep everything clear and organised, so you can focus on what matters — teaching and growing your centre.
